name: Flyover
description: Planes that are really flying over your home cross Kiosk Satellite's own screensaver, labelled with their flight number and aircraft type. Uses the Flightradar24 integration in Home Assistant. Visual only: taps go straight through to the screensaver.
author: Andromedanevel

settings.title: Maximum distance
settings.description: Only planes closer than this fly across the screen.

settings.title: Planes at once
settings.description: The nearest one or two planes.

settings.title: Only on screensaver views
settings.description: Comma-separated screensaver view names, as shown in the plugin status. Empty shows the planes over every screensaver.

settings.title: Height on screen
settings.description: Distance of the flight path from the top of the screen.

settings.title: Label
settings.description: TP1352 · A20N, AMS → LIS, Amsterdam → Lisbon or TP1352 · AMS → LIS. Planes without a known route show their flight number.

settings.title: Navigation lights at night
settings.description: Blinking strobe, beacon and wingtip light after sunset (sun.sun).

settings.title: Crossing time
settings.description: How long one pass across the screen takes.

settings.title: Pause between passes
settings.description: While a plane stays in range it comes round again after this pause.

settings.title: Frame rate
settings.description: Lower saves CPU on older tablets. The plugin draws nothing between passes.
